title: Proper Cartesian interchange identified with its sum-exchange mate
statement: For a finite commutative ring A and a Cartesian square (b,q,p,v) of Noetherian schemes with q,p proper and b,v separated quasi-compact etale, suppose derived sum exchange is invertible. Let F be the chosen compact-support functors [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Transport F_q F_v to F_b F_p using their compositors and congruence qv=bp. Conjugate its endpoints by the chosen proper [def-pur-graph-chosen-proper-comparison] and graph [def-pur-graph-chosen-etale-comparison] comparisons. The resulting natural transformation Rq_* S_v to S_b Rp_* is the mate of inverse sum exchange under the proper inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. No open source leg or terminal compactification of its composite occurs.

source.place: Tags 0F7B (proper/quasi-finite interchange), 0F7F (change of base), 0F7I and 0F7J (composition); proper/open tower in parent steps 1–3. Graph normalization: etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L.

proof.text: Let theta be the ordinary sheaf mate of canonical sum base change. Its section in the common direct image is the canonical sum inclusion, by the sheaf normalization lemma.

Apply the proper-support unit normalization with theta to compute the compact-support word after the source right-derived unit. Apply the proved Cartesian sum mate unit equation to compute the derived mate after that same unit.

The two computations have identical right sides. Transitivity and the uniqueness part of the right-derived universal property identify the two transformations. The source is the right-derived q_* followed by the exact derived S_v, with its canonical composite unit.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7F, separated into sheaf normalization, support-comparison unit normalization, and the categorical derived-mate calculation.

theorem graph_proper_interchange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {W Y' Z Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian W] [IsNoetherian Y'] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (q : W ⟶ Y') [IsProper q] (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p]
    (b : W ⟶ Z) [Etale b] [IsSeparated b] [QuasiCompact b]
    (v : Y' ⟶ Y) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (sq : IsPullback b q p v)
    [HasCompactification b] [HasCompactification v]
    [HasCompactification (q ≫ v)] [HasCompactification (b ≫ p)]
    [IsIso (((mateEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance)).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
        sq.toCommSq).hom)).natTrans)] :
    let sumEx := ((mateEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance)
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance)).symm
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq.toCommSq).hom)).natTrans
    let gam := (mateEquiv
      (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q)
      (mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (inv sumEx))).natTrans
    (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (graphChosenProperComparison A q).symm
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q)
        (graphChosenEtaleComparison A v).symm ≪≫
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A q v ≪≫
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A sq.w.symm ≪≫
      (unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A b p).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (graphChosenEtaleComparison A b)
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
        (graphChosenProperComparison A p)).hom = gam
